English: Carved Pebble
A humble stone, inscribed with the first runes, marking the clans new beginnings and uniting the people in shared tradition.
Rune Stick
Simple wooden sticks, carved with protective runes, are distributed among the clans to foster unity and tradition.
Wooden Rune Post
A tall wooden post, inscribed with clan history in runes, stands at the center of the camp, inspiring loyalty and memory.
Stone Rune Marker
A substantial stone set upright, etched deeply with runes that chronicle deeds and honor, strengthening the clans spirit.
Inscribed Boulder
A massive boulder, carved with complex runic tales, becomes the gathering place for council and ceremony.
Carved Standing Stone
A towering monolith, adorned with intricate runes and clan emblems, commands respect and awe from all who see it.
Runestone Circle
A ring of monumental stones, each bearing the names and deeds of the clans greatest, strengthens unity and draws visitors from afar.
Runemasters Shrine
A sacred place where skilled runemasters gather, preserving the lore and guiding the people in matters of tradition and spirit.
Saga Stone Monument
An awe-inspiring monument, its stones etched with the sagas of the clan, attracting distant kin and boosting the clans greatness.
High Runestone Sanctuary
The ultimate sanctum, a majestic circle of mighty runestones, revered across the land as the seat of clan unity and ancestral power.
